subject: general
question: India recently signed an MoU with the International Labour Organisation (ILO) to support the creation of which international framework aimed at improving job classification and skills comparability across borders?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**IRCO (International Reference Classification of Occupations)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India Signs MoU with ILO for International Job Classification.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
India has signed a **Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)** with the **International Labour Organisation (ILO)** to create the **International Reference Classification of Occupations (IRCO)**.

 
 
• 
 
This MoU aims to improve **global comparability of skills**, helping **Indian workers** gain access to international employment opportunities.

 
 
• 
 
The agreement was formalized in **Geneva** with key figures like **Ambassador Arindam Bagchi** and **ILO Director-General Gilbert F. Houngbo**.

 
 
• 
 
**Digital platforms** such as **National Career Service (NCS)** and **e-Shram Portal** are central to India's domestic **employment reforms**.

 

 
• **International Labour Organisation (ILO)**: Founded in **1919**, headquartered in **Geneva**, Switzerland. It sets international labor standards and promotes social justice.
